title: Monitoring waves
sub: A wave is a short check of what {name} has learned since the last one. It isn’t an exam: there’s no score for the child, and the report comes after the wave closes.

open.title: Wave {n} is open
open.device: The test opens full-screen. Use a tablet or computer if you can, and a quiet place.
how: {name} can skip a question and come back to it later.
Answers save as they go — if the connection drops, just keep going.
At the end {name} reviews everything and only then submits.
open.aloneBody: Help doesn’t improve the result — it only hides what {name} needs to work on. An honest blank answer is useful too: the report shows exactly that.

inProgress.title: Wave {n} is in progress
inProgress.body: Answers are saved as {name} goes. Continue on this or another device — it picks up where it stopped. The wave closes {date}.

notReady: Wave {n} is open, but its questions aren’t ready yet. Check back a little later.

row.takenNote: The report comes after the wave closes.

noConsentBody: Consent to process {name}’s data was withdrawn, so waves can’t be started. Waves already taken stay as they are.
emptyBody: When waves are scheduled for this grade, they appear here with their dates. Nothing to do until then.
noGradeTitle: No grade for this school year
noGradeBody: Waves follow the child’s grade. Once this year’s school and grade are set, the waves appear here.
loadError: Couldn’t load the waves just now.

errors.WAVE_NOT_OPEN: This wave isn’t open any more.
errors.WAVE_NOT_READY: This wave’s questions aren’t ready yet. Check back a little later.
errors.WAVE_TAKEN: This wave was already taken — the answers are submitted.
errors.WRONG_GRADE: This wave is for another grade. Check {name}’s grade for this school year.
errors.CONSENT_REQUIRED: Data-processing consent is off, so a wave can’t be started.
errors.NO_ENROLMENT: There’s no school and grade for this year yet — set them first.
errors.NETWORK: The connection dropped. Check your internet and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
